name: Ssalongo Fredrick Edward Walugembe
short: Leading the laity and serving St. Stephen's Church of Uganda, Luzira.
facts: Commissioner for Strategic Coordination & Implementation, OPM
Be a DOER of the WORD

bio.heading: About Mr. Fredrick Edward Walugembe
bio.content:
Mr. Fredrick Edward Walugembe is a seasoned public sector professional and Christian leader currently serving as the Head of Laity at St. Stephen's Church of Uganda, Luzira. He is a Commissioner for Strategic Coordination and Implementation in the Office of the Prime Minister, with extensive experience in public policy coordination, strategic planning, monitoring and evaluation, and institutional performance management.

With a distinguished career spanning several decades in public service, he has held senior leadership positions in the Office of the Prime Minister, Ministry of Public Service, and Ministry of Education and Sports. He is also internationally recognised for his professional contributions to statistics, holding the designations of Chartered Statistician and Chartered Scientist, and is a Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society.

He brings to church leadership a wealth of experience in strategic coordination, institutional development, accountability and teamwork, alongside a strong commitment to Christian service.

bio.heading: Leadership & Service Journey
bio.content:
Mr. Walugembe began serving at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira in 2019 and has progressively served in various leadership capacities at Church, Parish and Archdeaconry levels.

His previous and current leadership responsibilities include:

  • Head of Laity, St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira (current).
  • Assistant Head of Laity, St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira.
  • Assistant Head of Laity, Luzira Parish.
  • Treasurer, Luzira Archdeaconry (2022 to date).
  • Secretary, Estates and Development Committee, Luzira Parish (current).
  • Leadership and coordination of First Service and Morning Glory.

Through these responsibilities, he has contributed to the spiritual, administrative and institutional development of the Church, bringing his professional experience in coordination, financial accountability and strategic planning into the service of God's people.

bio.heading: Education & Professional Background
bio.content:
Mr. Walugembe has an extensive academic and professional background in statistics, business administration, education planning and public sector management.

Academic Qualifications

  • Master of Business Administration (MBA), Business Administration and Management – Eastern and Southern African Management Institute (ESAMI), 2013–2014.
  • Master of Statistics – Makerere University, 2000–2003.
  • Postgraduate Diploma in Statistics – Makerere University, 1999–2000.
  • Postgraduate Certificate in Education Planning and Administration for Education Planners – International Institute of Education Planning (UNESCO), Paris, France, 1997–1998.
  • Bachelor of Statistics (Honours) – Makerere University, 1988–1991.

Professional Recognition and Memberships

  • Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society.
  • Chartered Statistician, admitted on 18th April 2012.
  • Chartered Scientist, recognised in June 2012.
  • Elected Member of the International Statistical Institute (2007).
  • Member of the International Association of Survey Statisticians.
  • Member of the International Association of Official Statisticians.
  • Member of the Uganda Statistical Society.

Professional Career

He currently serves as Commissioner for Strategic Coordination and Implementation in the Office of the Prime Minister, a position he has held since February 2022. His work focuses on strengthening institutional frameworks for coordinating government policies and programme implementation across different sectors.

Previously, he served in several senior positions at the Ministry of Public Service, including Commissioner for Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation; Commissioner for Monitoring and Evaluation; and Assistant Commissioner for Coordination, Monitoring and Evaluation.

Earlier in his career, he served as Principal Statistician at the Ministry of Education and Sports, where he headed the Statistics and Data Processing Section and coordinated the implementation of the Education Management Information System (EMIS).

His professional experience is characterised by strategic leadership, analytical thinking, institutional coordination, performance management and results-oriented implementation.

bio.heading: Ministry & Areas of Service
bio.content:
Mr. Walugembe is committed to serving God through responsible leadership, stewardship and active participation in the life and development of the Church.

His experience in public sector leadership informs his approach to church administration, particularly in strategic planning, accountability, coordination, teamwork and institutional development.

He is passionate about strengthening church leadership, promoting effective stewardship and ensuring that the various ministries and departments work together towards a common vision.

bio.heading: Reflections on Christian Service
bio.content:
For Mr. Walugembe, serving at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira is both humbling and an opportunity to remain grounded and connected to reality.

His experience in different leadership positions within the Church has provided opportunities to serve God's people, appreciate the importance of teamwork and contribute to the development of the congregation.

As Head of Laity, he brings a commitment to responsible leadership, unity, effective coordination and the collective growth of the Church.

bio.heading: Scripture & Inspiration
bio.content:
Personal Guiding Principle: "Be a DOER of the WORD and, above all, take anything and everything to the Lord in prayer."

This principle reflects his conviction that Christian faith must be demonstrated through action and that every aspect of life should be surrendered to God through prayer.

It emphasises the importance of living according to God's Word, remaining prayerful and depending on His guidance in all circumstances.

bio.heading: Beyond Church Leadership
bio.content:
Beyond his professional and church responsibilities, Mr. Walugembe values personal growth, purposeful engagement and contributing meaningfully to society.

His professional interests include strategic coordination, institutional development, policy implementation, statistics, monitoring and evaluation, and finding practical solutions to complex organisational challenges.

He brings the same methodical, analytical and results-oriented approach that defines his professional career into his personal and community engagements.

bio.heading: A Message to the Congregation
bio.content: "Let us remain committed to being doers of God's Word and not hearers only. Whatever we encounter in life, let us take everything to the Lord in prayer, trusting in His wisdom, guidance and faithfulness. As a congregation, may we continue to serve together in humility, unity and love, putting our faith into action for the glory of God."

name: Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance
short: Serving the Third Service congregation and attached to the Treasury Department.

bio.heading: About Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance
bio.content:
Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance is a committed Christian, church leader and educationist with a longstanding connection to the Anglican Church. Born in Kasubi Nabulagala to the late Mr. and Mrs. Kiwanuka, she comes from a family with a rich Anglican heritage. Her maternal and paternal family backgrounds include the late Bishop Kawuma, her grandfather, and the late Rev. Eriazari Lwasi, her maternal grandfather.

She has served at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira since 2003, contributing to the growth and administration of the Church through various leadership responsibilities, particularly in financial management and stewardship.

Professionally, she has a background in banking, having worked with Stanbic Bank, and currently serves as the Rector/Director of Kyengera Central College. Beyond her professional and church responsibilities, she is passionate about sports, particularly netball and athletics, where she has demonstrated remarkable leadership and sporting achievement.

bio.heading: Leadership & Service Journey
bio.content:
Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance has been actively involved in the service of God at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira since 2003. Over the years, she has demonstrated commitment, reliability and dedication through various leadership appointments, particularly in financial stewardship and church administration.

Her previous leadership responsibilities include:

  • Treasurer, Mothers' Union, St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira.
  • Treasurer, Luzira Archdeaconry.
  • Treasurer, St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira.
  • Treasurer, Luzira Parish.

Currently, she serves as the Head of Laity for the Third Service and is attached to the Treasury Department. Her experience in financial management and church administration continues to contribute to the effective stewardship and development of the Church.

Through her years of service, she has demonstrated the importance of commitment, accountability and using one's professional abilities to serve God and His people.

bio.heading: Education & Professional Background
bio.content:
Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance has a professional background in banking, having previously worked with Stanbic Bank, where she gained experience in the financial sector.

She currently serves as the Rector/Director of Kyengera Central College, where she contributes to educational leadership and institutional management.

Her professional experience in banking and education provides a valuable foundation for her responsibilities in church leadership, particularly in financial stewardship, administration and organisational development.

bio.heading: Ministry & Areas of Service
bio.content:
Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance is particularly committed to serving God through church leadership, financial stewardship and the responsible management of church resources.

Her years of service as Treasurer at different levels of the Church reflect her dedication to accountability, effective resource management and the advancement of God's work.

She also values the importance of active participation in the life of the Church and believes that serving God is both a privilege and a source of personal fulfilment.

bio.heading: Reflections on Christian Service
bio.content:
For Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance, serving at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira is an opportunity to serve God, and it brings her great happiness. Her many years of involvement in the Church, beginning in 2003, reflect a longstanding commitment to Christian service and the life of the congregation.

Having served in various treasury positions at the Church, Parish and Archdeaconry levels, she has contributed to the financial stewardship and administration of the Church.

Her continued service as Head of Laity for the Third Service reflects her willingness to remain actively involved in the work of God and to use her experience and abilities for the benefit of the congregation.

bio.heading: Scripture & Inspiration
bio.content:
Favourite Scripture: Psalm 23 – "The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want."

This Psalm reflects her faith in God's guidance, provision, protection and unfailing presence throughout life's journey. It serves as a reminder that with God as our Shepherd, we can face life's challenges with confidence, knowing that He leads, sustains and provides for His people.

bio.heading: Beyond Church Leadership
bio.content:
Beyond her church and professional responsibilities, Mrs. Bigingo Jane Efrance is an enthusiastic sportswoman with a particular passion for netball and athletics.

Her sporting journey includes serving as captain of the She Cranes from 2010. She has also distinguished herself through individual sporting achievements, including recognition as the best centre player at the East and Central African Netball Championship and winning a gold medal in the high jump at the East and Central African Athletics Championship.

Her involvement in sports reflects her passion for discipline, teamwork, leadership and physical fitness. She continues to enjoy sports as an important part of her life outside church and professional responsibilities.

bio.heading: A Message to the Congregation
bio.content: "Serving God is a privilege and a source of great happiness. Let us continue to commit ourselves to His work, serve faithfully and use the gifts and abilities He has given us for the advancement of His Kingdom. May we always trust in the Lord, our Shepherd, knowing that He guides, provides for and sustains us throughout our journey of faith."

name: Nnalongo Sylvia Walugembe
short: Serving as Sub-Parish Mission Coordinator and Parish Church Treasurer, leading the church in mission, outreach, and faithful stewardship.
facts: Sub-Parish Education Coordinator, Parish Choir Coordinator, Archdeaconry Youth Coordinator (2022–2025)

bio.heading: About Mrs. Sylvia Walugembe
bio.content:
Mrs. Sylvia Walugembe is a devoted Christian and passionate servant of God whose journey of service reflects a heart for people, a love for the Church and a commitment to seeing lives transformed through Christ. She believes that serving God is not simply about holding a position, but about making a difference in people's lives, nurturing their faith and using the gifts God has given us to build His Church.

Over the years, she has served in various leadership capacities, bringing together her passion for Christian education, worship, youth development, missions and church stewardship. Her desire is to see believers grow in faith, discover their purpose and find joy in serving the Lord.

bio.heading: Leadership & Service Journey
bio.content:
Mrs. Walugembe's leadership journey has been shaped by a willingness to serve wherever God has called her.

From 2022 to 2025, she served in several capacities, including Sub-Parish Education Coordinator, Parish Choir Coordinator and Archdeaconry Youth Coordinator. Through these roles, she dedicated herself to nurturing believers in God's Word, supporting worship teams and guiding young people to grow in faith and purpose.

In 2026, her responsibilities expanded as she took on the roles of Mission Coordinator at Sub-Parish level and Church Treasurer at Parish level. These responsibilities have provided further opportunities to support the spread of the Gospel and promote faithful stewardship of the resources entrusted to the Church.

bio.heading: Ministry & Areas of Service
bio.content:
Mrs. Walugembe has a special passion for bringing people closer to God through prayer, worship, evangelism and fellowship. She finds fulfilment in seeing believers grow spiritually, come together in unity and experience the love and presence of God.

Some of the activities associated with her service include:

  • Morning Glory Services: Creating opportunities for believers to begin their days in God's presence through prayer, testimonies, praise and the sharing of His Word.
  • Intercessions: Mobilising dedicated prayer sessions for the Church, families, young people and the wider community.
  • Community Outreaches: Encouraging practical expressions of Christian love and evangelism by taking the message of Christ beyond the Church.
  • Overnight Prayers: Bringing believers together for meaningful times of prayer, worship and spiritual renewal.

Through these activities, she continues to encourage a culture of prayer, fellowship, active Christian service and deeper commitment to God.

bio.heading: Reflections on Christian Service
bio.content:
For Mrs. Walugembe, serving God is a privilege and an opportunity to be a blessing to others. Her journey has taught her that every role in the Church, whether visible or behind the scenes, matters in advancing God's Kingdom.

She finds joy in seeing people come together in prayer, grow in their understanding of God's Word and become more actively involved in the life of the Church. She believes that meaningful Christian leadership is demonstrated through love, humility, faithfulness and a willingness to serve.

Her prayer is that St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira will continue to grow into a spiritually vibrant and united congregation, where every member feels valued, discovers their gifts and finds an opportunity to serve God.

bio.heading: Scripture & Inspiration
bio.content:
Guiding Scripture: "Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters." — Colossians 3:23 (NIV).

This Scripture beautifully captures her approach to service. It reminds her that every responsibility, no matter how big or small, should be undertaken with love, dedication and a willing heart. Ultimately, her desire is not simply to serve people, but to honour God through everything she does.

bio.heading: A Message to the Congregation
bio.content:
"Dear brothers and sisters in Christ, let us continue to love God, love one another and serve Him with all our hearts. Every one of us has something valuable to contribute to the growth of His Church. Let us never underestimate the difference that a prayer, a kind word, a helping hand or a willing heart can make in someone's life.

May we remain united in faith, steadfast in prayer and joyful in service. Above all, may our lives reflect the love of Christ wherever we go. May God continue to strengthen us, guide us and use us to be a blessing to one another and to the generations to come.

To God be all the glory!"

short: Empowering young people to live boldly for Christ.
facts: Senior Engineer/Project Manager, Air Water Earth Limited.

• Registered Engineer, Engineers Registration Board (ERB) Uganda,
  • Member of Uganda Institution of Professional Engineers

• Master of Science in Civil Engineering, Makerere University (Distinction).
  • Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, Makerere University.

bio.heading: About
bio.content:
Eng. Itaaga Emmanuel is a Civil Engineer and Registered Engineer with both Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Civil Engineering from Makerere University, completing his Master's degree with Distinction. He currently works with Air Water Earth Limited as a Senior Engineer/Project Manager, with professional experience in road infrastructure development, construction supervision, project management and engineering consultancy.

Beyond his professional career, Emmanuel is passionate about Christian ministry, leadership development and nurturing young people. He serves as the Chairperson of the Youth Ministry at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira, where he is committed to building a generation of Christ-centred young people who are grounded in God's Word, discover their God-given purpose and actively participate in the mission of the Church.

He believes in purposeful living, servant leadership and using one's God-given gifts to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others. His interests include chess, music, playing the piano, continuous learning, technology and initiatives that promote personal growth and community transformation.

bio.heading: Leadership & Service Journey
bio.content:
Emmanuel's leadership journey is founded on a commitment to Christian service, stewardship and the development of others. In 2026, he took up the responsibility of Chairperson of the Youth Ministry at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira.

In this capacity, he provides leadership, coordination and strategic direction to the Youth Ministry, working with fellow youth leaders and members to strengthen fellowship, encourage spiritual growth and create opportunities for young people to discover and exercise their gifts in the service of God.

His leadership seeks to cultivate a vibrant, united and purpose-driven youth community that is actively involved in the life of the Church and committed to making a positive impact in society.

He believes that Christian leadership is not simply about occupying a position but about accepting the responsibility to serve, inspire and help others grow.

bio.heading: Academic Qualifications
bio.content:
• Master of Science in Civil Engineering, Makerere University (Distinction).
  • Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, Makerere University.

bio.heading: Professional Registration
bio.content:
• Registered Engineer, Engineers Registration Board (ERB), Uganda.
  • Member of Uganda Institution of Professional Engineers.

bio.heading: Professional Experience
bio.content:
• Senior Engineer/Project Manager, Air Water Earth Limited.
  • Experience in infrastructure development, construction supervision, project management and engineering consultancy.

bio.heading: Professional Journey
bio.content: His professional journey is driven by a passion for engineering excellence, innovation, sustainable infrastructure development and delivering projects that contribute meaningfully to society.

bio.heading: Ministry & Areas of Service
bio.content:
Emmanuel is passionate about Christian ministry, youth development and leadership formation. He believes that young people are not merely the Church of tomorrow but an important part of the Church today, with gifts, abilities and a responsibility to contribute meaningfully to God's mission.

As Chairperson of the Youth Ministry, his vision is to build a vibrant, united and purpose-driven ministry that nurtures young people into Christ-centred individuals who are grounded in God's Word, confident in their identity and courageous in living out their faith.

His areas of focus include:

  • Spiritual Growth and Discipleship: Nurturing young people in the knowledge of God's Word and helping them develop a personal and lasting relationship with Christ.
  • Leadership Development and Mentorship: Identifying, nurturing and empowering young people to become responsible Christian leaders and positive influences in society.
  • Early Engagement and Guidance: Creating opportunities to engage young people early, understand their questions and challenges, and guide them through the complexities of the world in which they are growing up.
  • Christian Character and Witness: Encouraging young people to reflect Christ through their conduct, love, faith, service and integrity.
  • Fellowship and Unity: Strengthening relationships, belonging and collaboration among young people and across the wider Church.
  • Purpose and Personal Development: Helping young people discover their God-given gifts, develop their potential and use their abilities to serve God and their communities.

He believes that effective youth ministry must go beyond speaking about Christ to demonstrating Christ through authentic relationships, consistent Christian character and practical acts of service. His desire is to build a ministry that does not judge first but seeks to understand, nurture and guide young people in love.

bio.heading: Reflections on Christian Service
bio.content:
For Emmanuel, serving at St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira is both a privilege and a responsibility. It is an opportunity to express his love for God through service, use the gifts and abilities entrusted to him, and contribute to the growth of God's Church.

Having served largely in supportive roles for much of his leadership journey, he views his current responsibility as Chairperson of the Youth Ministry as a new season of responsibility, courage and leadership. He recognises that leadership is not about personal recognition or authority but about stewardship, accountability and the willingness to serve others faithfully.

He believes that leadership must be exercised with integrity, transparency, humility and dedication. He also recognises that no leader succeeds alone; meaningful progress requires collective commitment, cooperation, prayer and a shared vision.

His approach to youth ministry is shaped by the realities facing young people today. With changing social values, increasing exposure to complex influences and growing questions about faith, he believes the Church must become more intentional in engaging, understanding and guiding the younger generation. Rather than waiting until young people have lost their way, the Church must invest in them early, create safe spaces for honest conversations and provide guidance rooted in God's Word.

He is particularly convinced that the Christian faith must be demonstrated as much as it is taught. When young people encounter authenticity, consistency and Christ-like character, trust is built, hearts remain open and the seeds of faith can take root. He also believes that the impact of ministry is not always immediate; sometimes the seeds planted today bear fruit many years later.

His hope is to see St. Stephen's C.O.U. Luzira become an increasingly united, spiritually vibrant and purpose-driven Church, with a Youth Ministry that is one of its strong pillars. He desires to see young people who are firmly rooted in Christ, confident in their God-given purpose and equipped to influence their generation positively.

bio.heading: Scripture & Inspiration
bio.content:
Favourite Scripture:

"For still the vision awaits its appointed time; it hastens to the end—it will not lie. If it seems slow, wait for it; it will surely come; it will not delay." — Habakkuk 2:3 (ESV).

This Scripture is a reminder that God's purposes unfold in His perfect timing. It encourages patience, perseverance and faith, particularly when the fulfilment of a vision seems distant or progress appears slow.

For Emmanuel, it reinforces the importance of remaining faithful to God's calling, continuing to work diligently towards the vision entrusted to us and trusting God throughout the journey.

bio.heading: Personal Guiding Principle
bio.content:
"Leadership is Stewardship."

He believes that every opportunity, gift, responsibility and position entrusted to us is an opportunity to serve God and make a difference in the lives of others. True leadership is therefore measured not by the position one holds but by the impact one makes through faithful service.

bio.heading: Beyond Church Leadership
bio.content:
Beyond his professional and church responsibilities, Emmanuel enjoys playing chess, football and supporting Manchester United. He is also passionate about music, particularly playing the piano, and enjoys listening to contemporary gospel music.

He spends his free time exploring new ideas and technologies, travelling, learning new skills and engaging in activities that promote personal and professional growth. He also values meaningful conversations, building relationships and pursuing initiatives that challenge him to become better.

His interests reflect a desire for continuous learning, creativity, personal development and purposeful living.

bio.heading: A Message to the Congregation
bio.content:
"May we continually recognise that every gift, opportunity and responsibility entrusted to us is an opportunity to serve God and make a difference in the lives of others. Let us remain faithful in our calling, united in purpose and intentional about building a Church whose impact extends beyond our generation.

To the young people, never underestimate what God can accomplish through a willing heart. Discover your gifts, grow in faith, embrace responsibility and dare to pursue the purpose God has placed within you. Remember that you are not merely the Church of tomorrow; you are an important part of the Church today.

May we continue to serve faithfully, love genuinely and shine brightly for Christ, each in our own generation."
